Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, an Argentinian American man in his early fifties, a stubborn, bull-necked grill master: short and stocky with a very thick neck, a broad chest, a hard round belly and short thick legs, tanned skin, short curly black hair going grey at the temples, one thick black eyebrow right across his brow, a big flat nose with wide nostrils, dark stubble and a stubborn, glowering closed mouth, wearing bright green sneakers. He wears exactly the same kit as the character in image[1] (plain white short-sleeved jersey, plain mid grey shorts, dark charcoal grey socks) and is made in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, surface texture, level of detail, lighting and background as image[1], but is a completely different person: a different face, skin colour, hair, age and body, with no grey hair, no moustache and no narrow eyes: curly black hair, a thick single eyebrow and a wide nose. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
